gloss: municipalities; cities, wards, towns, and villages

definitions.gloss: municipalities; cities, wards, towns, and villages
definitions.explanation: A collective term for the four types of local government units in Japan: cities (市), special wards (区), towns (町), and villages (村). Used to refer to local municipalities as a group.

examples.japanese: {市区町村|しくちょうそん}コード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}する→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧。
⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{都道府県|とどうふけん}→都道府県：14502_todoufuken⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{市区町村|しくちょうそん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write the address with the prefecture and municipality separated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{市区町村|しくちょうそん}のうち、⟦{人口|じんこう}{減少|げんしょう}→人口減少：24385_jinkougenshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直面|ちょくめん}している→直面する：15862_chokumensuru⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Among all municipalities nationwide, many are facing population decline.

notes:
A four-character compound listing the four types of basic local government in Japan: ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧ (city), ⟦{区|く}→〜区：01997_ku⟧ (ward), {町|ちょう} (town), {村|そん} (village). Frequently encountered on government forms and official documents.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧: city — population generally over 50,000
- ⟦{区|く}→〜区：01997_ku⟧: ward — the 23 special wards of Tokyo
- {町|ちょう}: town — smaller than a city
- {村|そん}: village — the smallest unit

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市区町村|しくちょうそん}コード: municipality code
- {市区町村|しくちょうそん}{名|めい}: municipality name
- {市区町村|しくちょうそん}⟦{合併|がっぺい}→合併：04778_gappei⟧: municipal merger

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{都道府県|とどうふけん}→都道府県：14502_todoufuken⟧: prefectures — the level above municipalities in Japan's administrative hierarchy
- ⟦{自治体|じちたい}→自治体：13946_jichitai⟧: local government body — a broader term for any autonomous local entity
- {基礎自治体|きそじちたい}: basic municipality — the formal administrative term
